params.name: since
params.description: Only return sessions on or after this ISO 8601 datetime. Useful for incremental sync.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per page. Min 1, max 100.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor for the next page of results, from a previous `next_cursor`.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of reading sessions for the authenticated user,
ordered by date descending (newest first).

Each session records a single reading period with a timestamp and duration.
Use these to compute reading streaks, daily totals, or other time-based
statistics client-side.
